name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A2
pathways: negative regulation of RNA-dependent RNA polymerase activity

function.text: EIF4A2 encodes eukaryotic initiation factor 4A-II. Annotated molecular activities include helicase activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. It participates in negative regulation of RNA-dependent RNA polymerase activity and translational initiation.
